purpose: The flatten runs in a Web Worker and returns exactly what it returns on the page's thread; one job at a time, the newest wins, and a worker that cannot start is not an outage.

checks.name: answerFlatten returns exactly what flattenDraft returns
checks.detail: 2 pieces, 985 sweeps, sound true

checks.name: the solver settings in the request are the ones used
checks.detail: a request naming max_iterations 5 stops at sweep 5

checks.name: a bad request is answered with an error, not thrown
checks.detail: error: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'map')

checks.name: the shipped worker file, on a real thread, returns exactly what the main thread computes
checks.detail: 985 sweeps, 2 reports, deep-equal

checks.name: the same worker serves the next job
checks.detail: one worker spawned for two jobs, mode worker

checks.name: the same heavy job on the worker and on the main thread agree
checks.detail: 60000 sweeps

checks.name: while the worker runs a long job the main thread keeps running
checks.detail: ticks kept coming during the job; the same job inline held every timer until it was over

checks.name: a newer job drops the long one running on a real thread and is answered
checks.detail: the first job rejected as superseded, the second answered, two workers spawned (the busy one ended)

checks.name: a job is posted once, stays pending until the worker answers, then resolves
checks.detail: request {id, pieces, solver} posted; nothing resolved before the reply

checks.name: newest wins: the old job is dropped and its worker ended, a late reply to it is ignored
checks.detail: first rejected as superseded, first worker terminated, second worker answered

checks.name: cancel drops the job and ends the worker
checks.detail: rejected as superseded, worker terminated

checks.name: an error reply rejects that job only; the worker is kept and serves the next
checks.detail: rejected with the worker's message, one worker for both jobs

checks.name: a reply that carries another job's id is ignored
checks.detail: the ghost of job 1 left job 2 pending; job 2 resolved with its own answer

checks.name: a worker that fails to start: the job finishes inline, and so do all later ones
checks.detail: resolved by the inline flatten, worker ended, no second worker, reason recorded

checks.name: no Worker in this environment: every job runs inline
checks.detail: the spawn was tried once, then never again

checks.name: a request that cannot be posted (not cloneable) finishes inline
checks.detail: postMessage threw DataCloneError, the job ran inline

checks.name: a worker that never answers: after the deadline the job finishes inline, and the runner stays inline
checks.detail: resolved by the inline flatten, worker ended, reason recorded, the next job never went to a worker

checks.name: an answer in time cancels the deadline
checks.detail: still a worker after the deadline would have passed

checks.name: a dropped job's deadline does not fire on the job that replaced it
checks.detail: the second job resolved by its worker, no fall back to inline

checks.name: inline: it yields first, and a job dropped before its turn never runs
checks.detail: A superseded before it started, only B ran

checks.name: inline: a failure of the flatten itself rejects the job with that error
checks.detail: rejected, not superseded

checks.name: the worker's import graph is relative modules only, and none touches the DOM
checks.detail: 13 modules: core/flatten/flatten_core.mjs, core/flatten/flatten_mesh.mjs, core/flatten/flatten_patch.mjs, core/flatten/flatten_report.mjs, core/flatten/flatten_solver.mjs, core/flatten/flatten_stall.mjs, core/surface_path.mjs, features/pattern/dxf_pieces.mjs, features/pattern/dxf_writer.mjs, features/pattern/flatten_job.mjs, features/pattern/flatten_worker.mjs, features/pattern/pattern_draft.mjs, features/pattern/pattern_templates.mjs

checks.name: the page creates the worker in the one form the bundler recognises, and it points at the entry
checks.detail: new Worker(new URL('../../features/pattern/flatten_worker.mjs', import.meta.url), { type: 'module' }) → src/features/pattern/flatten_worker.mjs

checks.name: the entry answers every message through answerFlatten
checks.detail: self.onmessage → self.postMessage(answerFlatten(event.data))
